annotations.title: Capture against an authorized payment session

description: Captures amount_units from an authorized session: POST /v1/sessions/:id/capture with amount_units and request_id. This is the step that settles funds; amount may be partial (up to the session maximum). Idempotent: replaying the same request_id returns the original capture instead of double-charging. After capture (or when ttl elapses) the session moves to 'captured' / 'expired' and the remainder is released.

amount_units.description: Amount to capture in smallest units (6 decimals for USDC), e.g. '1250000' = $1.25; must not exceed the session maximum.

request_id.description: Unique client-generated idempotency key; safe retries return the same capture instead of double-charging.

session_id.description: Authorized session ID to capture against.

name: phantom_capture_session

text.description: Response body of the IDPHANTOM API as a JSON string.

isError.description: True when the API call failed; text carries { error: { code, message } }.
